T: Road trip to Hollywood, snacks for the whole way.
D: Two slackers from New Jersey head to Hollywood to stop a movie being made about them.
P: Serve the banana splits when Suzanne the orangutan makes her escape.
S: Jay and Bob thumbing a ride across the country

Sourdough toasties packed with cheddar, pepper jack and pickled jalapeños, grilled in garlic butter until crunchy, cut into fingers with a smoky tomato relish. Mix 50g soft butter with 1 crushed garlic clove. Grate 150g cheddar and 100g pepper jack or tasty cheese. Drain and chop 3 tbsp pickled jalapeños. Fill 8 slices of sourdough with the cheeses and jalapeños, spread garlic butter on the outsides and cook in a pan over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down, until golden and melting. Cut into fingers and serve with 150g tomato relish stirred with a pinch of smoked paprika.
Craft service grilled fruit with chilli lime
the craft service table on the Hollywood studio lot

Pineapple, rockmelon and watermelon wedges charred on a hot grill, sprinkled with chilli lime salt, with a honey, lime and mint yoghurt dip. Cut half a pineapple, a quarter of a rockmelon and a wedge of watermelon into thick spears. Heat a grill pan or barbecue very hot and char the pineapple and rockmelon 1 to 2 minutes a side, leaving the watermelon raw. Mix 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp chilli powder and the zest of 1 lime. Stir 200g Greek yoghurt with 2 tbsp honey, lime juice and chopped mint. Arrange the fruit, sprinkle with chilli lime salt and serve with the dip.
Jersey smoked ham and cheese sliders
home turf in New Jersey before the road trip

Thick smoked ham slices fried until caramelised and curled, stacked on toasted slider buns with melted American cheese, yellow mustard and pickles. Cut 400g thick smoked ham into 8 slices about 5mm thick and nick the edges. Fry in a little butter over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until caramelised. Lay a slice of American cheese on each, add a splash of water and cover for 30 seconds to melt. Toast 8 slider buns cut side down in the pan. Spread with yellow mustard, add the ham and cheese and top with sliced pickles.
M: the fast food stop on the way west
Two smashed beef patties with cheese, pickles and sauce on toasted buns, wrapped in paper.
lunch on the Hollywood studio lot

Triple-decker toasted sandwiches of roast chicken, crisp bacon, avocado, tomato and cos with garlic mayo, cut into quarters and served with salted crisps. Grill 8 bacon rashers until crisp. Shred 500g roast chicken. Toast 12 slices of white bread. Mix 100g mayo with 1 crushed garlic clove. For each sandwich, spread 3 slices with mayo, layer chicken, avocado and cos on the first, bacon and tomato on the second, and top with the third. Pin with 4 toothpicks, cut into quarters and serve with 150g salted crisps.
W: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
Bananas split lengthways with vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream, hot fudge, whipped cream, nuts and a cherry.
K: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
Raspberry cordial blended with plenty of ice and a squeeze of lemon until slushy, served in big cups with straws.

m.note: the fast food stop on the way west
m.how: Roll 600g beef mince into 8 balls and smash flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook 2 minutes. Flip, add American cheese and cook 1 minute more. Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and 4 tbsp mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, then wrap in paper.

w.note: Suzanne, the orangutan they bust out
w.how: Split 4 bananas lengthways into 4 dishes. Add a scoop each of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream. Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100ml cream for hot fudge and pour over. Top with whipped cream, chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: the drinks machine at the Quick Stop
d.how: Blend 200ml raspberry cordial with 600g ice, 200ml cold water and the juice of 1 lemon until smooth and slushy. Pour into 4 big cups and serve straight away with straws.
